tools.name: fireflink_signin
tools.description: Sign in to FireFlink using credentials configured in environment variables or passed as optional parameters. Automatically configure the license and project from environment variables.

emailId.description: Optional FireFlink email ID (defaults to FIREFLINK_EMAIL_ID environment variable)

password.description: Optional FireFlink password (defaults to FIREFLINK_PASSWORD environment variable)

tools.name: fireflink_list_scripts
tools.description: Lists all scripts in the configured project. Optionally filter by module ID or name.

module.description: Optional module ID or module name to filter scripts

tools.name: fireflink_get_script
tools.description: Fetches an automation script, removes DOM locators, checkpoints, and bloat, and returns a token-efficient, model-readable outline with step IDs, inputs, and variable references. The model reviews this outline against standards and calls action tools to remediate issues.

scriptId.description: Script ID or script name alias

module.description: Optional module ID or module name (automatically inferred if omitted)

moduleId.description: Optional module ID or module name alias

project.description: Optional project ID or project name (defaults to configured project)

tools.name: fireflink_create_variable
tools.description: Creates a new variable in FireFlink at LOCAL, GLOBAL, or PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT scope.

scriptId.description: Script ID or name (required when scope is LOCAL)

script.description: Alias for script ID or name

module.description: Alias for module ID or name

tools.name: fireflink_rename_variable
tools.description: Renames an existing variable and automatically updates step references in the script.

variableId.description: ID of the variable to rename (or variable name)

variable.description: Alias: current variable name or ID

script.description: Alias for script ID or name

module.description: Alias for module ID or name

tools.name: fireflink_replace_hardcoded_input
tools.description: Replaces a hardcoded value on a step input parameter with a reference to a variable.

script.description: Alias for script ID or name

stepId.description: Step ID where the hardcoded value is used

inputName.description: Input argument name on the step

variableId.description: ID of the variable to link

variableName.description: Name of the variable to link

module.description: Alias for module ID or name

tools.name: fireflink_import_webservice_collection
tools.description: Starts a FireFlink webservice collection and imports a Postman collection JSON file.

tools.name: fireflink_start_webservice_collection
tools.description: Starts the FireFlink webservice collection for the specified project and returns the first collection key.

tools.name: fireflink_rename_script
tools.description: Renames a FireFlink script to adhere to descriptive naming standards.

module.description: Optional module ID or module name

tools.name: fireflink_get_script_details
tools.description: Retrieve a FireFlink script by its key (e.g. SCR1644) or full name. Matching is case-insensitive. Returns the script details without internal metadata fields.

searchValue.description: Script key or name to search for. Matching is case-insensitive.

tools.name: fireflink_add_script
tools.description: Create an automation script inside the ACOE_AI module in FireFlink. Stores the newly created script ID in the session for subsequent automation operations.

scriptName.description: Name of the automation script to create in FireFlink

tools.name: fireflink_create_script
tools.description: Create an automation script inside the ACOE_AI module in FireFlink. Stores the newly created script ID in the session for subsequent automation operations.

scriptName.description: Name of the automation script to create in FireFlink

tools.name: fireflink_add_step
tools.description: Adds an automation step to the active FireFlink script using the selected NLP ID and its input values. Provide nlpId and optional inputs. For element-based NLPs, you can either provide an existing element using elementid=ELEMENT_ID, or create a new element using elementName, elementType, and element=[locatorType=locatorValue,...]. For other NLPs, provide the input names and values exactly as returned by fireflink_get_nlp_details.

inputs.description:
Comma-separated key=value pairs.

For an existing repository element:
elementid=ELE4b5de9b5-1e74-448a-a4b0-eddc089127ef

For a new element:
elementName=UserName_Manual,elementType=textfield,element=[xpath=//INPUT[@id='username']]

For non-element NLPs:
seconds=10

Use either elementid OR the new-element format, not both.
Use the exact input names returned by fireflink_get_nlp_details.
The active script must already be selected.

tools.name: fireflink_get_nlp_list
tools.description: Fetch all available FireFlink NLPs and return their names, IDs, and descriptions. Use this to identify the correct NLP for a test step.

tools.name: fireflink_search_nlps
tools.description: Search FireFlink NLP metadata using a keyword or automation action. Returns only matching NLP IDs. Use these IDs to retrieve NLP details.

searchText.description: NLP keyword or action, e.g. Click, Enter Text, Login

platform.description: Optional platform filter, e.g. Web, Mobile

limit.description: Maximum number of results. Defaults to 10.

tools.name: fireflink_get_nlp_details
tools.description: Get the exact NLP ID, display name, step inputs, and return type for a specific FireFlink NLP using its NLP ID. Use the NLP ID returned by fireflink_search_nlps.

nlpId.description: FireFlink NLP ID returned by the search tool.

tools.name: fireflink_refresh_nlp_metadata
tools.description: Refresh the FireFlink NLP metadata cache by fetching the latest NLP catalogue.
